title: second lens verdict
description: The only shape either lens may answer in. Both lenses read tools/lens_prompt.md and answer this file, so a verdict from one is comparable with a verdict from the other. Kept to the subset a structured-output provider accepts strictly -- types, enums, required and additionalProperties, and nothing else -- because a keyword the provider silently drops is a constraint that is enforced on one lens and not the other.

lens.description: The lens that answered: codex, or claude-fable-fallback.

verdict.description: pass only when the lens tried to break the change and could not.

findings.description: One entry per hole found, most severe first. Empty on pass.

rule.description: Which of the five rules this finding is under.

reads.description: How many files the lens actually opened. A pass with no reads is a lens that did not look.
